citations.narrative:
The facility does not have an adequate pest control program in place for mammalian pests. Inside the enclosures housing
three capybaras, the inspector saw mouse/rat droppings on and around the food and water receptacles as well as on top
of the shelters.
Pests such as mice and rats can spread disease and contaminate food, surfaces, and animal housing areas. A safe and
effective program for the control of insects, ectoparasites, and avian and mammalian pests shall be established and
maintained.
To be corrected by July 20, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
